# unrelated lessons. The gate therefore asserts the resolved record CONTAINS its anchor, so id
# drift fails loudly instead of quietly grading the wrong thing.
# Committed before any adapter existed (ADR-0706), so the set cannot be bent to flatter the
# results it grades. The five content-positional ids carried `unresolved:` placeholders until
# the id grammar first ran; a loader MUST FAIL on a leftover placeholder rather than skip a row.
